videos.title: The RIGID ROLL The MOST DOMINANT Way To WIN in ARMWRESTLING
videos.summary:
THE RIGID ROLL — The MOST DOMINANT Way to WIN in ARMWRESTLING

What if you could completely dismantle your opponent without EVER allowing them to feel the strength of your muscles?

After 14 years of armwrestling, I've come to understand something fundamental about dominating at the table.

The most effective way to defeat an opponent isn't to overpower their muscles. It's to deny them the opportunity to use those muscles in the first place.

Welcome to THE RIGID ROLL.

This is a technical approach to armwrestling that combines several powerful mechanics into one devastatingly efficient movement.

It starts with JOINT RIGIDITY.

By establishing a strong wrist-up post, we create a connected, structurally rigid arm that allows force to travel through our joints rather than being absorbed by muscular stretch.

From there, the magic happens.

Short, sharp SIDE PRESSURE.

Perfectly timed SUPINATION.

Relentless FINGER FLEXION.

And finally, a seamless transition into the TOPROLL.

Each component serves a specific purpose, but the real power comes from understanding how they work TOGETHER.

The objective is simple:

Never give your opponent the opportunity to load their muscles.

Never allow them to establish meaningful tension.

Never let them find the position where their strength becomes relevant.

Instead, use structure, timing and intelligent force application to progressively dismantle their ability to resist.

In this video, I break down the mechanics of the Rigid Roll, explain WHY it works, and demonstrate how you can begin developing this incredibly effective approach to armwrestling.

This isn't about having the biggest biceps.

It's not about having the strongest back pressure.

And it's certainly not about simply pulling harder than your opponent.

It's about making your opponent's strength IRRELEVANT.

Because at the highest levels of armwrestling, the athlete who controls WHERE the strength is applied will often defeat the athlete who simply possesses MORE of it.

Watch closely. Understand the mechanics. Then take this concept to the table and experience the difference for yourself.

👇 QUESTION FOR YOU:

Have you ever armwrestled someone who felt absolutely immovable, despite knowing you were physically stronger?

There's a good chance you've experienced exactly what we're discussing in this video.

videos.title: ROTATION is the KING of Denial NEVER FEAR a HOOKER With BIG BICEPS Again
videos.summary:
The strongest biceps in the room don’t necessarily belong to the man who controls the match.

One of the biggest mistakes you can make in armwrestling is seeing an opponent with terrifying hook strength and thinking you have only two choices:

Run from it… or fight it head-on.

There is a third option — and that sweet spot in between is where ROTATION becomes king.

In this video, I break down how I use rotation to derail an opponent’s access to their biceps without completely abandoning the fight. Rather than trying to out-curl someone whose greatest weapon is their bicep, the goal is to change the direction of the pressure, compromise their connection and force their strength to operate in a lane where it becomes far less threatening.

This is an important distinction.

You're not necessarily trying to escape their hook.

You're not blindly committing to beating their hook either.

You're denying them the version of the fight they want.

And that leads to one of the most important principles I've learned in armwrestling:

Taking your opponent somewhere THEY are weak is often more valuable than simply going where YOU feel strong.

That's what makes armwrestling so much more than a test of horsepower.

The best pullers aren't just asking:

“Where am I strongest?”

They're asking:

“Where does this opponent stop being dangerous?”

Once you start thinking that way, rotation becomes more than pronation or a technical movement. It becomes a weapon of denial — something that allows you to stay connected to the fight while systematically taking away the qualities your opponent desperately wants to use.

If you've ever gripped someone with enormous biceps and immediately thought “I cannot let this guy hook me”, this video is for you.

Don't run from their strength.
Don't attack it head-on.
DERAIL IT.
